INDEPENDENT EXACT-SHA REVIEW — PASS

Candidate C = 601de2a0b31a5453ee82905e696c1949dda619be. First parent B = da355b1c7ed7d34fe504cfddfde2e11ec7a3d823. Reviewer was a read-only subagent who did not author the remediation. Diff scope is exactly the four ticket paths (50 insertions, 220 deletions).

Semantic-preservation matrix (B:path:line -> C:path:line; B=C means byte-identical content):
| ID | Verdict | Contract | Concrete before/after evidence |

| S03 | PASS | Bash-only grep-family tokens | B:5-29,38-39 -> C:4-8,17-18; executable C:28-39 checks tool_name == Bash and command string, and C:18 preserves grep/rg/egrep/fgrep lexical boundaries. |

| S05 | PASS | no permissionDecision | B:5-29 -> C:4-8; C:60-65 contains only hookEventName and additionalContext. Focused test at tests/unit/test_serena_grep_reminder_hook.py:123-133 pins omission. |
| S06 | PASS | malformed/nonmatch is silent exit 0 | B:5-29 -> C:6-8; C:42-58 and 66-70 preserve return 0 on read/JSON/shape/nonmatch/write failures with no prior stdout. Tests :95-103,135-159 cover nonmatch, malformed input, and non-Bash. |

| S35 | PASS | hook tests consumer | B=C:tests/unit/test_serena_grep_reminder_hook.py:66-166,175-258 covers tokens, silence, single context envelope, permission neutrality, malformed input, settings, tracking, and foreign-cwd wiring. |
| S36 | PASS | manual Jira pressure-test guide | B=C:scripts/jira-pressure-test/README.md:1-39 and docs/jira-sync-setup.md:303,516 still mark both probes manual/outside CI, name distinct opt-ins, preconditions, connected mutations, and cleanup risk. |
| S37 | PASS | pressure preflight tests consumer | B=C:tests/scripts/test_jira_pressure_test_preflight.py:21-69,284-537 retains per-probe opt-ins, required adapter operations, checkout tools, preflight-before-mutation, and override coverage. |
| S38 | PASS | exact protected directives/sanctions/shebangs | Byte comparison found hook 1, field probe 4, general probe 2 protected lines identical. Includes B:field:112 -> C:109 exact “# shellcheck disable=SC2329 # invoked via trap”; tickets-boundary-ok at B/C field:54, B:312 -> C:285, and B/C general:235; all three shebangs remain line 1. |
| S39 | PASS | only documentation/comment/blank changes | Python normalized-AST equality passed for both Python files; explicit shell audit found all 227 +/- shell lines are standalone comments/blanks; git diff names only the four declared paths. |

Independent command evidence against C:
- git diff --check C^ C on all four paths: PASS (rc 0).
- normalized Python AST comparison after stripping docstrings and TypeIgnore line positions: PASS, 2/2.
- explicit shell changed-line audit: PASS, 227/227 +/- lines comment-or-blank.
- protected line byte comparison: PASS (1 hook + 4 field + 2 general lines).
- focused pytest tests/unit/test_serena_grep_reminder_hook.py tests/scripts/test_jira_pressure_test_preflight.py: PASS, 39 passed in 360.06s.
- make lint against exact C: PASS (rc 0). It was rerun because two comment corrections distinguish C from the earlier author-linted tree.
- ticket-stored BRE-style escaped grouping with Git ERE matcher reproduced rc 1 / 28,961 diff bytes; semantically identical proper ERE reproduced rc 0 / 0 bytes. The explicit 227-line audit is the primary proof; signed ticket material was not modified.
- Full test suite intentionally not run per comment/documentation-only session scope.
